svg.text: NEW AVALON — ARCHITECTURAL SCHEMATIC I: SPIRE ELEVATION, WARDS 1–15 & UPPER STRATA
Kingdom of Arclean • Merged Canonical Blueprint (Replaces v0.4 Page 21 Hand-Drawn Schematic) • Base: 3 Miles Wide → Summit: 1 Mile Wide at 14,000 ft

g.text: Each Ward consists of Low, Mid, and High/Upper Concentric Circles (100–200 ft tall each; 1/2 to 3/4 mile deep into the core)
UPPER SPIRE TAPER: ~2 MILES WIDE (SUMMIT: 1 MILE WIDE)
No exterior windows (50-ft armor wall; 3×3 ft shuttered slits) • Airship Moorings
200-ft Circles • 200-ft private hanging terrace gardens • Wall Merchant Mansions
150-ft Circles • 200×100 ft glass windows • Peasant Path Terminus • Public Parks
Wholesale commodity exchanges, guild production halls & merchant counting houses
Master guild workshops, clockwork machinists, gunsmiths & specialty artisans
Equestrian stables, livestock pens & massive exterior step-back agricultural shelf
Senior factory foremen, skilled industrial operators & municipal machinists
Heavy textile mills, refineries, steam-loom complexes & shift dormitories
Foundry workers, bulk manufactories & dense working-class blocks
100×50 ft exterior windows every 1/2 mile allow natural sunlight into Low Circle
State orphanages, military/guild pensioners, Crown charity soup kitchens & tenements
Unpatrolled by Constables • Controlled by syndicate gangs • Secret Warren entrances
Vast Mela fungal/algal vats, grain silos, slaughterhouses & ration granaries
2 • MILITARY WARD ("Soldier Ward" — 400 ft Total Height)
50 Bridges to 150-ft Inner Wall • Largest Military Arms Bunkers • First Exterior Slits/Windows
1 • LABOR WARD (225–300 ft Total Height • Surface & Sub-Surface)
Agricultural field laborers, Sea Port dockers & heavy haulers • Blast Gates to Fields
SUBTERRANEAN • THE WARRENS & ANCIENT SUMPS (BELOW SEA LEVEL)
Collapsed pre-Wilheart tunnels, Geothermal Exchange Pipes, Smuggler Docks & Neither Dwellers
BASE FOOTPRINT AT SEA LEVEL: 3 MILES WIDE (DIAMETER) • NEITHERCRETE HULL
PEASANT PATHS (4 VERTICAL SHAFTS: WARDS 1–13) & NOBLE PATHS (WARDS 1–15)
B. THE CITY COUNCIL / ROYAL PRIVY COUNCIL (25 SEATS)
Advises King Macelus Wilheart on law, taxation & defense (King retains absolute Royal Veto)
TOTAL: 25 MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL (5 King + 3 Noble + 2 Collegium + 15 Wards)
Wards 10–15 elect Representatives • Middle Wards appointed by Guilds • Lower Wards appointed by Crown Magistrates
C. UPPER SPIRE CUTAWAY: NEITHER → THE ZONE → AITHER
Above the Zone, Neithercrete crumbles in sunlight; upper tiers use Granite Stone & Steel
THE ROYAL PALACE (14,000 FT SUMMIT • 1 MILE WIDE)
Sovereign Sky Estates • Private Gunpowder Arms Bunkers
Lesser Noble villas, private sky-gardens & cantilevered upper decks
Direct household access up to Noble estates
2 Privy Council Seats • Research observatories, Aither laboratories
SKY DOCKS • FOREIGN AREA & TRADE QUARTERS
Foreign Embassy Enclaves ("NO LIVING" for ordinary citizens)
Self-policed sovereign compounds • Dedicated Sky Dock Arms Bunkers
50-ft solid armor wall against Zone storms • Only 3×3 ft steel slits
Terminus of Noble Paths & Freight Lifts
200-ft Circles • 200-ft private hanging terrace gardens in Low Circle
Wall Merchant mansions with private Cartridge/Converter Arms Bunkers
150-ft Circles • 200×100 ft glass windows • Exterior public orchard parks
Upper Terminus of the 4 Peasant Path Vertical Shafts
